# Barberous

> Barbershop in Hadath, Lebanon. Haircuts, beard grooming, face care, hair color and keratin treatment. Prices in USD. Appointments are requested on WhatsApp and confirmed by the shop.

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: +961 70 576 915
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/barberous.byelie/
- Directions: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9kXkQLaUTHoh73pz9
- Address: Hadath, Baabda District, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon
- Coordinates: 33.833007, 35.5317624

## Hours

- Monday–Saturday: 10:00–20:00
- Sunday: 10:00–14:00

## Prices (USD)

Hair & beard
- Hair & beard: $20
- Haircut: $13
- Beard trim: $7
- Junior haircut: $10
- Hair styling: $5

Hair color & treatment
- Basic hair color: $100
- Keratin treatment: $50
- Beard color: $15

Face
- Face mask: $7
- Eyebrow shaping: $6
- Nose & ear waxing: $7

Grooming package
- Grooming service (haircut, beard, nails and face mask): $30

## Barbers

- Elie Chehade — owner and barber
- Mohamad — barber

## Booking

Walk-ins are welcome. Each service row on the site opens WhatsApp with a prefilled request. The shop confirms manually; nothing is reserved automatically.
